entities.summary: Michael and Alexis Romanov's consolidation: recovery from the Time of Troubles, the Raskol (Old Believer schism, 1654), Cossack expansion (Khabarov's Amur expeditions), the annexation of Left-Bank Ukraine (Pereyaslav Agreement, 1654), and Stenka Razin's rebellion (1670–71).
